verdict.rationale: Twenty ships AI agents, so letting them consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product, but the evidence never documents connecting or registering third-party MCP servers. The pricing line "MCP server: Yes" describes Twenty exposing its own MCP server (the server role), which does not transfer to this client-side story. App-defined tools and skills, and the HTTP-request workflow step, are developer building blocks or adjacent features rather than MCP-client support.
